title: Frequency Matters: Fast Model-Agnostic Data Curation for Pruning and Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2603.16105v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Post-training model compression is essential for enhancing the portability of Large Language Models (LLMs) while preserving their performance. While several compression approaches have been proposed, less emphasis has been placed on selecting the most suitable set of data (the so-called \emph{calibration data}) for finding the compressed model configuration. The choice of calibration data is a critical step in preserving model capabilities both intra- and inter-tasks. In this work, we address the challenge of identifying high-performance calibration sets for both pruning and quantization by analyzing intrinsic data properties rather than model-specific signals. We introduce ZipCal, a model-agnostic data curation strategy that maximizes lexical diversity based on Zipfian power laws. translated_title: 频率至关重要：用于剪枝和量化的快速模型无关数据策展方法
translated_abstract: 训练后模型压缩对于增强大型语言模型（LLMs）的可移植性同时保持其性能至关重要。尽管已有多种压缩方法被提出，但对于选择最合适的数据集（即所谓的“校准数据”）以确定压缩模型配置的重视程度较低。校准数据的选择是保持模型在任务内和任务间能力的关键步骤。在本工作中，我们通过分析数据的内在属性而非模型特定信号，来解决为剪枝和量化识别高性能校准集的挑战。我们引入了ZipCal，一种基于Zipf幂律最大化词汇多样性的模型无关数据策展策略。实验表明，我们的方法在各种剪枝基准测试中优于标准的均匀随机采样方法。值得注意的是，它在其他方面也表现出色。
tldr: 本文提出ZipCal，一种基于Zipf幂律最大化词汇多样性的模型无关数据策展方法，通过分析数据内在属性而非模型信号，为剪枝和量化高效选择高性能校准数据，显著优于均匀随机采样。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ZipCal, a model-agnostic data curation strategy that maximizes lexical diversity based on Zipfian power laws, efficiently selecting high-performance calibration data for pruning and quantization by analyzing intrinsic data properties, outperforming uniform random sampling.
